It is not a theory course, program note, plot,\\n+mood labeler, therapy, authority-with-answer, or captioned performance.\\n+Main real value projections: perceptual resolution of psychological change · WHY-NOW causal\\n+sense-making · experience articulation/recognition/felt-contact/human-process · synchronized\\n+method/instrument encounter · whole-work deep session · interpretive openness · competence\\n+permission (barrier overlay) · effort-honest seriousness.\\n+\\n+## Audience motivation space\\n+\\n+Core audience dimensions: work familiarity × desired reward (hear/name/understand/be-met/contact/\\n+process) × competence self-concept × explanation-autonomy × effort preference × self-relevance\\n+need × classical identity approach/avoid. 26 modeled audience states, 10 motive clusters.\\n+Latent non-classical audiences: complex-experience/essay readers, causal/systems thinkers,\\n+long-form depth users, film/game-score attentive listeners, competence-shamed curious,\\n+cross-genre sophisticated listeners (9 latent routes R01–R09).\\n+Main barriers: category misprediction (\\\"classical = history/lecture/not-for-me\\\"), competence\\n+permission, unclear payoff for effort, identity signaling; NOT lack of perceptual ability.\\n+\\n+## Signal decoding\\n+\\n+Important signals: professional/scholarly tone, emotional/experiential questions, work-name\\n+prominence, \\\"听懂\\\", \\\"引导\\\", \\\"心理\\\", long-text density, minimal visuals, composer portrait,\\n+abstract imagery, large value claims, product-native time/interface grammar.\\n+How different audiences decode them: every signal is polysemous across audience states — e.g.\\n+professionalism = quality to insiders / gate to outsiders; \\\"引导\\\" = scaffold to novices /\\n+hand-holding to autonomy experts; portrait = classical anchor to fans / biography-category trap\\n+for latents; density = depth signal to NFC users / effort wall to insecure novices.\\n+40 signal entries with per-audience decodes, FP paths and FN paths are in\\n+`frozen/SIGNAL_TO_AUDIENCE_CAUSAL_LEDGER.json`; distinct motive, FP/FN and drift per aperture.\\n+main audience: complex-experience/language users, recognition seekers, felt-contact seekers,\\n+literary/process close readers incl. non-classical latents\\n+repelled: technical formalists; partially valuable loss of psychology-skeptical experts\\n+false-positive: quote/essay (a), self-help/diagnosis (b), wellness/regulation (c), topic/story (d)\\n+false-negative: none structural; guarded by checksums\\n+title role: [piece-grounded human tension] + [piece] + [listening-model id]; It is not a theory course, program note, plot,\\n+mood labeler, therapy, authority-with-answer, or captioned performance.\\n+Main real value projections: perceptual resolution of psychological change · WHY-NOW causal\\n+sense-making · experience articulation/recognition/felt-contact/human-process · synchronized\\n+method/instrument encounter · whole-work deep session · interpretive openness · competence\\n+permission (barrier overlay) · effort-honest seriousness.\\n+\\n+## Audience motivation space\\n+\\n+Core audience dimensions: work familiarity × desired reward (hear/name/understand/be-met/contact/\\n+process) × competence self-concept × explanation-autonomy × effort preference × self-relevance\\n+need × classical identity approach/avoid. 26 modeled audience states, 10 motive clusters.\\n+Latent non-classical audiences: complex-experience/essay readers, causal/systems thinkers,\\n+long-form depth users, film/game-score attentive listeners, competence-shamed curious,\\n+cross-genre sophisticated listeners (9 latent routes R01–R09).\\n+Main barriers: category misprediction (\\\"classical = history/lecture/not-for-me\\\"), competence\\n+permission, unclear payoff for effort, identity signaling; NOT lack of perceptual ability.\\n+\\n+## Signal decoding\\n+\\n+Important signals: professional/scholarly tone, emotional/experiential questions, work-name\\n+prominence, \\\"听懂\\\", \\\"引导\\\", \\\"心理\\\", long-text density, minimal visuals, composer portrait,\\n+abstract imagery, large value claims, product-native time/interface grammar.\\n+How different audiences decode them: every signal is polysemous across audience states — e.g.\\n+professionalism = quality to insiders / gate to outsiders; \\\"引导\\\" = scaffold to novices /\\n+hand-holding to autonomy experts; portrait = classical anchor to fans / biography-category trap\\n+for latents; density = depth signal to NFC users / effort wall to insecure novices.\\n+40 signal entries with per-audience decodes, FP paths and FN paths are in\\n+`frozen/SIGNAL_TO_AUDIENCE_CAUSAL_LEDGER.json`; title+thumbnail+visual are judged as one rendered\\n+joint package with collision tests (e.g. recognition text + generic emotion art → psychology/\\n+quote miscategory).\\n+\\n+## Strategy families\\n+\\n+### F01 — LISTENING RESOLUTION / PERCEPTUAL RE-HEARING\\n+outward identity: re-hear a known object with higher resolution\\n+main value projection: hearable internal change made trackable\\n+main audience: familiar-but-blurred listeners; [L7]     "diff": "@@ -0,0 +1,167 @@\n+# Final Report — Guided Full Packaging Ontology V1\n+\n+STATUS: **PASS** — all deliverables produced; `STOPPED_BEFORE_GENERATION = YES`\n+\n+Authority chain: locked product context → Wave-1 eight independent identical-prompt ontology\n+reports (`wave1/A01..A08`) → normalized `CLAIM_LEDGER.json` → web Canonicalizer C0 → five\n+Reviewer/Blind-Judge rounds → **frozen ontology** (`frozen_ontology/`) → Wave-2 eight\n+independent identical-prompt platform reports (`wave2/P01..P08`) → web platform synthesis → two\n+Reviewer/Blind-Judge rounds → **frozen contracts** (`final_contracts/`). Full provenance:\n+`RESEARCH_PROVENANCE.md`.\n+\n+This report answers the mandatory questions of the task pack (`10_STOP_AND_DELIVERABLES.md`,\n+`00_MAIN_AGENT_PROMPT.md` §14). It summarizes frozen artifacts; it does not replace them.\n+\n+## A. TITLE\n+\n+**What it is:** the primary propositional precision and retrieval surface of the entry package —\n+an identity/search anchor plus a conditional service/mode promise. It is not a miniature essay,\n+not a plot, and not an emotional essence of the work.\n+\n+**It should carry:** sufficient unambiguous work identity for the actual publishing context\n+(composer/work/version tokens only as needed for disambiguation or evidenced retrieval); a Guided\n+Full mode cue only where material service/category ambiguity remains and the smallest accurate cue\n+measurably reduces it; at most a bounded, explicitly local entry aperture as a testable experiment.\n+\n+**It must NOT carry:** a whole-work thesis, a fixed story, a premature emotional essence, or any\n+claim that survives on packaging habit rather than mechanism.\n+\n+**Whole-piece coverage:** not required and not desirable. The title represents the *transaction*\n+(what object + what kind of experience), never the 80-atom semantic space.\n+\n+**Legitimate selectivity vs false totalization:** selectivity is legitimate when it selects\n+decision-relevant information (identity, mode, audience fit). It becomes false totalization when\n+grammar or positioning promotes one local facet into \"what the work is.\" An entry point becomes an\n+interpretive anchor as emotional specificity, narrative completeness, implied temporal scope,\n+cross-surface repetition, and pre-music priority increase.\n+\n+**Question/statement/search-identity forms:** justified exactly when they serve retrieval or\n+reduce service/category ambiguity for the target audience (theory: expectation fidelity +\n+category correction); unjustified when used as curiosity hooks that trade accurate expectation for\n+clicks (marketing habit).\n+\n+## B. THUMBNAIL\n+\n+**What it is:** the rapid perceptual classification/recognition/salience surface — category cue,\n+recognition signal, attention selector, brand gestalt. High perceptual bandwidth, very low\n+propositional bandwidth. It is *not* an explanation and *not* a second title.\n+\n+**Belongs in title, not thumbnail:** precise identity, propositional promise, qualification,\n+anything requiring reading.\n+\n+**Series-fixed variables:** recognition-bearing constants of the Guided Full family may be fixed\n+(series signature/geometry/tone) because they solve repeated classification at zero per-item cost.\n+\n+**Piece-specific variables:** piece-specific imagery/metaphor is epistemically UNKNOWN at glance\n+bandwidth and test-gated; it becomes harmful when presented as whole-work representation.\n+Composer portrait = legitimate identity/category cue, insufficient as value proposition.\n+\n+**Text:** compensatory, not default — only for a measured title-visibility/classification failure\n+that cannot be solved more cleanly. The first valid comparison is always the actual\n+platform-native/no-custom state (an *editorial* null whose incidental semantics must be recorded);\n+a deliberately designed \"minimal\" image is still an active intervention.\n+\n+## C. PRE-ROLL VOICE\n+\n+**Default: `NONE`.** `NONE` is a first-class deployable state, not a gap.\n+\n+**The specific problem voice could solve:** residual mode/usage uncertainty that survives\n+title + visual + page context + Guided UI. Whether such residual uncertainty exists is an open\n+empirical question (O-026): the UI's self-explanatoriness has *never been tested with novices*.\n+\n+**Why UI-insufficiency claims need proof:** direct research shows pre-listening verbal frames alter\n+perception/enjoyment/attribution; the burden of proof is therefore on adding speech, and the\n+current opening was deliberately designed to teach the mode in use.\n+\n+**When `NONE` is strictly better:** whenever no measured residual job exists, whenever speech\n+would overlap musical onset, or whenever the proposed content duplicates what Guided Full supplies\n+at higher temporal resolution.\n+\n+**If ever admitted:** piece-independent usage clarification only (default-purpose branch), ending\n+before onset, tested against literal zero-speech with the frozen acceptance vector (comprehension/\n+deference improvement without worsening onset handoff, sustained listening, load, interpretive\n+diversity, autonomy). A partial, non-authoritative piece-specific frame exists only as a\n+high-burden research branch; totalizing/fixed-story/authoritative framing remains forbidden.\n+\n+## D. POST-ROLL VOICE\n+\n+**Default: `NONE`.** Music gets the experiential last word.\n+\n+**Independent value:** currently undemonstrated. Replay ≠ transfer; repeated exposure raises\n+familiarity/liking (direct evidence), but no evidence shows a spoken cue produces autonomous\n+listening skill. Transfer claims require later reduced-guidance/unguided outcomes under\n+replay-matched designs with silent-end and smaller/nonspoken comparators.\n+\n+**Aftereffect risk:** music-induced state persists past the final sound (direct evidence);\n+speech-caused *disruption* of that state is plausible but unmeasured — treated as a guardrailed\n+cost, not assumed harm, and there is no universal \"safe seconds\" number.\n+\n+**Summary:** omitted by default — retrospective totalization of an intentionally plural work.\n+\n+**CTA:** belongs to a separate marketing/navigation system, routed out of the listening service;\n+platform-native mechanisms may serve economics only if perceptually/semantically separable from\n+the ending.\n+\n+## E. JOINT SYSTEM\n+\n+Title + thumbnail form **one joint selection package** with expectation-class consistency and no\n+semantic duplication (title owns precision/retrieval/promise; visual owns fast classification).\n+Voice does **not** belong to the packaging service: entry selection and in-video framing are\n+different jobs over different audience states. The derived architecture is one orchestration\n+boundary with two independently optional modules — `PRE_ROLL` and `POST_ROLL` — each able to\n+return literal `NONE`; `{PRE_ROLL: NONE, POST_ROLL: NONE}` is complete and valid. A single\n+undifferentiated \"voice script\" object is forbidden.\n+\n+## F. PLATFORM DIFFERENCE (mechanistically real)\n+\n+Grounded in documented mechanics only:\n+- YouTube: 100-character title field behavior/truncation; native title/thumbnail A/B testing\n+  judged by watch-time share; automatic 4:5 thumbnail substitution for vertical videos on\n+  Home/feeds (treatment-fidelity check required); the 2026-08-24 view-count definition change\n+  (metric continuity caution); end-screen/navigation mechanics separable from the musical ending.\n+- Bilibili: current common cover geometry norms; numeric title-length rules and search/retrieval\n+  vocabulary differences; 播放时长指数 labeled 内测中 (capability check before relying on it).\n+\n+Rejected as unsupported: \"platform X users like Y\" audience psychology, cultural-stereotype\n+packaging, and generic creator folklore. Language/nomenclature differences are interface facts,\n+not audience-mind facts.\n+\n+## G. EMPIRICAL PLAN (post-launch priorities)\n+\n+Full design in `final_contracts/EMPIRICAL_VALIDATION_PLAN.md`; headline tests:\n+1. Title: product-promise vs whole-work-thesis vs bounded-local-aperture, on qualified selection +\n+   expectation fidelity + interpretive diversity (falsifier: thesis titles match or beat on all).\n+2. Thumbnail: editorial null vs designed low-semantic cover (active control) vs piece-metaphor arm,\n+   measuring category-correct selection, whole-work decoding, priming/later anchoring.\n+3. Pre-roll MODE_CUE_EXPERIMENT: zero-speech comparator + frozen acceptance vector; deployment\n+   additionally requires later reduced-guidance outcome.\n+4. Post-roll transfer: silence + timing comparator + replay-matched design + smaller/nonspoken\n+   comparator; deployment requires autonomous-transfer benefit surviving controls.\n+5. Metrics tied to the product objective: qualified click, expectation-fidelity proxy, early\n+   retention, sustained listening, returning viewership, autonomy indicators. Known\n+   optimization traps called out explicitly: raw CTR, platform engagement proxies, replay rate,\n+   platform-A/B \"winners\" (which optimize the platform's objective, not ours).\n+\n+## Remaining uncertainty (honest register)\n+\n+Unresolved empirical gates are explicit in the frozen artifacts: novice mode-comprehension status\n+untested; thumbnail metaphor net value unknown; cross-surface repetition interaction form unknown;\n+post-musical speech effect direction unknown; transfer effect existence unknown; Bilibili analytics\n+availability volatile. None were silently filled with assumptions.\n+\n+## Deliverable index\n+\n+- Source/provenance: `source/SOURCE_PROVENANCE.md`, `RESEARCH_PROVENANCE.md`\n+- Wave 1: `wave1/A01..A08/turn_text.md`, `wave1/CLAIM_LEDGER.json`, run manifests\n+- Ontology loop: `synthesis/`, `reviewer*/`, `judge/r0001..r0005/`, champions archived\n+- Frozen ontology: `frozen_ontology/` (+ `ONTOLOGY_FINAL.sha256`,\n+  `ONTOLOGY_CONVERGENCE_REPORT.md`)\n+- Wave 2: `wave2/P01..P08/turn_text.md`, run manifest\n+- Contracts loop: `platform*/`, judges, champions archived\n+- Frozen contracts: `final_contracts/` (+ `PLATFORM_CONTRACTS_FINAL.sha256`,\n+  `PLATFORM_CONVERGENCE_REPORT.md`)\n+- Self-review: `FINAL_SELF_REVIEW.md`\n+\n+`STOPPED_BEFORE_GENERATION = YES` — no title generation, no cover generation, no image generation,\n+no TTS, no voice script, no renderer change, no video render, no Canonical change, no production\n+code change.\n@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@\n+# Mandatory Final Self-Review — vs `09_ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.md` and `11_FINAL_SELF_REVIEW.md`\n+\n+STATUS: **PASS**\n+\n+## Historical contamination\n+- [x] No First Listen as current product anywhere in deliverables (locked context enforced in every prompt; judges explicitly checked \"no deprecated-product leakage\" each round)\n+- [x] No Theory/Deep product assumptions introduced\n+- [x] No old title candidates smuggled into recommendations (zero production candidates produced)\n+\n+## Method\n+- [x] Wave 1: 8 agents, byte-identical prompt (`96965756…`), identical source pack (`6cecbdef…`), same model policy, independent fresh Temporary conversations, no role-splitting, full outputs retained with per-run metadata\n+- [x] Wave 2: 8 agents, byte-identical prompt (`c354f84a…`), identical pack including frozen ontology (`2da7e375…`), same policy; every agent covered BOTH platforms and all four surfaces\n+- [x] Independence preserved (no sibling outputs in any input bundle; verified by manifest contents)\n+- [x] One infrastructure failure disclosed and retried fresh (ontology r0005 websocket timeout; wave-1 mass TLS failure archived)\n+\n+## Ontology quality (frozen artifacts)\n+- [x] Product objective derived (constrained vector; raw CTR rejected) — `AUDIENCE_STATE_MODEL_FINAL.json`, principles §2\n+- [x] Audience-state model complete incl. pre-exposure retrieval gate, staged listening states, post-musical/transfer states\n+- [x] Title / thumbnail / pre-roll / post-roll ontologies defined (master + causal ledger)\n+- [x] No-intervention baselines first-class for every object (incl. editorial-null thumbnail distinction)\n+- [x] Independent harms modeled and mechanism-separated (priming vs anchoring; preload vs split attention; authority vs dependence; closure overwrite vs aftereffect disruption; false totalization; wrong-audience attraction; expectation mismatch)\n+- [x] Interaction effects modeled (joint package, repetition, cross-surface consistency)\n+- [x] Evidence confidence explicit (`EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md`, DIRECT_RESEARCH / STRONG_ANALOGY / PLATFORM_EVIDENCE / REASONED_INFERENCE / UNKNOWN)\n+- [x] Falsifiers explicit throughout the causal ledger\n+\n+## Ontology convergence\n+- [x] Synthesis created by a fresh web canonicalizer (not main-agent summarization)\n+- [x] Reviewer directly returned complete revised challengers (9-file sets), not findings-only\n+- [x] Blind Judge used every round with randomized SLOT_A/B and private mappings retained\n+- [x] No fixed round counter; stopped only on judge's MINOR + no shared gap → ONTOLOGY_CONVERGED (r0005)\n+- [x] Frozen set hash-manifested (`ONTOLOGY_FINAL.sha256`) before any Wave-2 work\n+\n+## Wave 2 method\n+- [x] Same-prompt independence as Wave 1\n+- [x] Current official evidence used for time-sensitive claims; judges revalidated live (YouTube title limit/watch-time A/B/4:5 substitution/view-count change; Bilibili cover geometry/播放时长指数 内测中)\n+- [x] No platform-role split (each P-report covers both platforms × all surfaces)\n+\n+## Platform specificity\n+- [x] YouTube contract concrete (title/thumbnail/pre-roll/post-roll/analytics/testing, evidence register, open unknowns)\n+- [x] Bilibili contract concrete (same structure; numeric title rule; search mechanics; beta-metric capability checks)\n+- [x] Shared vs native rules separated (`GUIDED_FULL_PACKAGING_PRINCIPLES.md` inclusion rule; platform contracts hold the native mechanics)\n+- [x] No unsupported audience stereotypes (principles §12 forbids them; judges audited this)\n+- [x] Metrics tied to product objective; optimization traps named\n+- [x] Experiment/falsification plan exists (`EMPIRICAL_VALIDATION_PLAN.md`)\n+\n+## Service ontology\n+- [x] Title service boundary derived from audience states/jobs (inputs, outputs, I-01..I-10 invariants, forbidden behavior, platform hooks, validation API)\n+- [x] Thumbnail service boundary derived (semantic brief inputs, series-fixed vs piece-variable, division rules, category decision contract)\n+- [x] Voice service boundary derived: one orchestration boundary, two independently optional modules\n+- [x] `NONE` is legal output where appropriate (first-class in both modules)\n+- [x] Title+thumbnail joint relationship explicit (division rules; contradiction ban; measured-repetition-only rule)\n+- [x] Pre/post voice not forced into one service without reason (§9 boundary principle documents why not two separate services and why not one undifferentiated script)\n+\n+## Scope\n+- [x] No final title generated\n+- [x] No final thumbnail generated\n+- [x] No production voice script generated\n+- [x] No image generation; no TTS\n+- [x] No renderer changes; no video render; no Canonical changes\n+- [x] No production code changes (experiment directory + docs only)\n+\n+## Known limitations (disclosed, non-blocking)\n+- External research relies on web agents' cited searches; citation links are recorded inside their reports rather than re-verified by the lead agent.\n+- The claim ledger is a clerical normalization by the lead agent; full reports ship unmodified beside it so the canonicalizer's inputs are fully auditable.\n+- Platform mechanics drift over time; contracts therefore pin capability checks (e.g., Bilibili beta analytics) instead of static assumptions.\n+\n+No material item fails. STATUS = PASS.\n@@ -0,0 +1,107 @@\n+# Research Provenance — Guided Full Packaging Ontology V1\n+\n+Experiment root: `experiments/guided_packaging_ontology_v1/`\n

It is not a theory course, program note, plot,\nmood labeler, therapy, authority-with-answer, or captioned performance.\nMain real value projections: perceptual resolution of psychological change · WHY-NOW causal\nsense-making · experience articulation/recognition/felt-contact/human-process · synchronized\nmethod/instrument encounter · whole-work deep session · interpretive openness · competence\npermission (barrier overlay) · effort-honest seriousness.\n\n## Audience motivation space\n\nCore audience dimensions: work familiarity × desired reward (hear/name/understand/be-met/contact/\nprocess) × competence self-concept × explanation-autonomy × effort preference × self-relevance\nneed × classical identity approach/avoid. 26 modeled audience states, 10 motive clusters.\nLatent non-classical audiences: complex-experience/essay readers, causal/systems thinkers,\nlong-form depth users, film/game-score attentive listeners, competence-shamed curious,\ncross-genre sophisticated listeners (9 latent routes R01–R09).\nMain barriers: category misprediction (\"classical = history/lecture/not-for-me\"), competence\npermission, unclear payoff for effort, identity signaling; [L2]   "content": "# ENTRY PACKAGE DESIGN CONTRACT — r0008\n\n## 0. Scope\n\nThis contract governs the **entry layer only**: the external package that lets a prospective viewer classify a Guided Full release, decide whether its promised value matters now, and enter with expectations that the product can fulfill. It is concrete enough to generate and evaluate future title/thumbnail concepts, but this document deliberately contains **no production title or cover**.\n\nThe product layer is binding and unchanged. The entry layer may project value actively; it may not convert Guided Full into a different commodity to obtain clicks.\n\n## 1. Package objective\n\nA valid package must maximize **qualified attraction**, not raw attraction.\n\nQualified attraction means:\n\n> the package attracts a named motive; the actual first contact fulfills that motive in the promised currency; the viewer can tolerate the real effort and epistemic stance; and a healthy return reason remains work-dependent rather than migrating to an adjacent commodity.\n\nA package is not invalid merely because it repels some people. Repel is healthy when those people require a commodity structurally absent from Guided Full.\n\n## 2. Required design inputs\n\nBefore generating package candidates, the design agent must have all of the following:\n\n1. **Exact work identity** and any genuine current-session relevance.\n2. **Product evidence** for the work: salient transitions, recurrence, carried history, WHY_NOW relations, alternatives, and whole-work shape actually present in Guided Full.\n3. **Primary acquisition family**: exactly one of F01–F05.\n4. **F03 aperture**, if F03 is primary: exactly one dominant aperture A03a–A03d. Secondary apertures may support but may not blur the acquisition thesis.\n5. **Named audience motive/state hypothesis**, including expertise axes, competence security, perceived effort, density tolerance, self-relevance need, and adjacent-category prior where relevant.\n6. **Attract / healthy repel / false positive / valuable false negative hypothesis.**\n7. **First-contact fulfillment statement:** what the entrant should be able to receive or test in the first product moments.\n8. **Return hypothesis:** why a satisfied entrant would want another work rather than another quote/topic/lesson/tool feature.\n9. **Long-term shaping hypothesis:** what 20–50 repetitions of this logic would teach the market the channel is.\n10. **Evidence status:** product fact, report convergence, prior theory, derived challenger inference, or unresolved experiment.\n\nIf any of items 3–8 are missing, do not generate a package yet; the strategy is underspecified.\n\n## 3. Six stable truths every package must preserve\n\nThese are not six clauses that must literally appear in copy. They are six truths the combined package must make recoverable without contradiction.\n\n### T1 — Object truth\n\nThe object is a **specific musical work being heard**, not generic psychology, generic life advice, a composer biography, a story summary, or a music-theory lesson.\n\n### T2 — Time/method truth\n\nThe product works **with the music unfolding in time**. Synchronized guidance, current/past relation, timing/progress, or equivalent product-native evidence should make this transaction legible.\n\n### T3 — Effort truth\n\nThe experience is serious and may be text-dense. Removing false prerequisites must never imply effortless, passive, ambient, or “quick summary” use.\n\n### T4 — Epistemic truth\n\nInterpretation is a model that can be tested against the work, not a diagnosis, composer-intent fact, fixed plot, or uniquely correct answer. Where source-supported alternatives exist, the package must not erase them.\n\n### T5 — Whole-work truth\n\nGuided Full is a complete-session product. Even when the entry hook centers one hinge, the package must not imply that the product is merely a short clip, isolated trivia answer, or single-moment explainer.\n\n### T6 — Return truth\n\nThe durable reason to come back must be reusable on another work: re-hearing, temporal sense-making, experience-dependent close reading, use of the listening instrument, or another complete guided session. The return reason must not require the same psychological topic, quote style, famous composer, or interface novelty.\n\n## 4. Family Materiality Test\n\nBefore treating a proposed strategy as a new family, compare it with the nearest existing family on five dimensions:\n\n1. dominant pre-click reward;\n2. signal/category architecture;\n3. audience selection vector;\n4. first-contact fulfillment mechanism;\n5. 20–50-release channel identity and production backflow.\n\nA new family must differ materially on **at least four of five**. Otherwise classify it as an aperture, layer, or package variant. This prevents small copy variations from masquerading as strategy diversity.\n\n## 5. Family semantic skeletons\n\nThe skeletons below are **semantic roles**, not production copy templates.\n\n### F01 — Listening Resolution / Perceptual Re-hearing\n\n**Title job:** identify the work and project a concrete before→after listening value: a distinction, return, transformation, or relationship that can become easier to hear.\n\n**Thumbnail job:** isolate one perceptual hinge or changed relation, not a theory symbol and not generic emotion.\n\n**Fast category read:** “a different hearing of this work.”\n\n**Required proof:** work identity + audible/time-bound hinge + product-native listening context.\n\n**Avoid:** correctional “you missed it,” beginner identity, ear-training notation, formal mechanism as the reward.\n\n### F02 — WHY-NOW Causal Inquiry / Temporal Sense-Making\n\n**Title job:** create a bounded causal gap whose answer depends on what happened earlier and what is happening now.\n\n**Thumbnail job:** show a before→now or return-with-memory relation, not a generic “WHY?” disconnected from music.\n\n**Fast category read:** “this musical moment becomes intelligible through its history.”\n\n**Required proof:** temporal dependency + work anchor + interpretive rather than composer-intent/formal certainty.\n\n**Avoid:** pretending the package can prove the composer’s motive; formal-analysis bait; answering the puzzle completely before entry.\n\n### F03 — Experience-First Close Reading\n\n**Title job:** project a humanly meaningful experiential reward with enough specificity to create relevance, while making clear that the reward is discovered/tested through the work rather than supplied as standalone psychology.\n\n**Thumbnail job:** one experiential hinge linked to time/work; the music or synchronized method cannot become background decoration.\n\n**Fast category read:** “a hard-to-name human experience becomes more legible through listening to this work.”\n\n**Required proof:** declared aperture + work/time checksum + non-diagnostic stance + first-contact music dependence.\n\n#### A03a — Articulation / Sayability modifier\n\nLead on the value of **finding precise language** for an experience. The language must function as a listening hypothesis, not a collectible quote. Thumbnail semantics should point to a specific change or tension rather than a standalone aphorism.\n\n#### A03b — Recognition / Being-Met modifier\n\nLead on **felt recognition** only when the work genuinely supports the experience. Direct address must be bounded; it may invite recognition, not announce who the viewer is. The package must show early that recognition is a bridge into attentive listening, not diagnosis or advice.\n\n#### A03c — Present-Tense Felt Tracking modifier\n\nLead on **following an unstable experience as it changes now**. Avoid regulation, relaxation, mindfulness, “healing,” or mood-management cues. Density/conflict/non-resolution must remain plausible from the package.\n\n#### A03d — Human-Process / Trajectory modifier\n\nLead on a **process**—for example, return, withdrawal, testing, remembering, acting, refusing, revising—not a fixed character/story diagnosis. The process thesis must remain incomplete without the musical temporal evidence.\n\n### F04 — Synchronized Method / Listening-Instrument Encounter\n\n**Title job:** make the listening instrument itself legible as a novel way to attend, while keeping the musical work as the reason the method matters.\n\n**Thumbnail job:** product-native screenshot or equivalent interface evidence showing synchronization/time/progress/interpretive relation.\n\n**Fast category read:** “try this unusual way of listening to this work.”\n\n**Required proof:** actual product-native visual + work identity + substantive value beyond UI novelty.\n\n**Avoid:** AI/software/data-viz spectacle, feature list, generic “new technology,” interface without musical payoff.\n\n### F05 — Piece-First Deep Session / Whole-Work Ritual\n\n**Title job:** make the exact work and complete serious encounter the acquisition motive, while articulating enough transaction value that the package is not merely an archive label.\n\n**Thumbnail job:** work identity + session/whole-work depth cue + distinctive Guided Full method/benefit.\n\n**Fast category read:** “a complete guided encounter with this exact work.”\n\n**Required proof:** full-session format, effort honesty, specific value beyond familiarity/status.\n\n**Avoid:** composer portrait as default category signal, prestige-only seriousness, “complete guide” that sounds encyclopedic, work title alone for cold audiences.\n\n## 6. Cross-family layer rules\n\n### L01 — Interpretive Agency / Open Model\n\nUse to protect epistemic agency when certainty or psychologizing risk is present. Valid signals include model-not-verdict language, test/rebuttal affordance, or genuine alternatives. L01 cannot be the sole reward unless a work’s actual branching/alternative structure is itself unusually central—and even then the underlying acquisition family must remain legible.\n\n### L02 — Competence Recalibration / Prerequisite Reset\n\nUse when a high-fit audience may falsely self-exclude because it assumes theory knowledge, elite vocabulary, or specialist classical identity is required. L02 must follow this sequence:\n\n**remove false prerequisite → disclose real effort → hand off to F01–F05.**\n\nNever promise “easy” merely because theory is unnecessary. Never let “beginner” become the durable channel identity.\n\n## 7. Signal hierarchy contract\n\nEach package should assign signals to four functional roles:\n\n1. **Category anchor:** what is this transaction?\n2. **Value driver:** why enter this release now?\n3. **Boundary cue:** what adjacent commodity is this *not*?\n4. **Effort/method proof:** what will using it actually feel like?\n\nA package is weak when all visible signals perform the same role. For example, work title + composer portrait + opus number may all anchor category while projecting almost no differentiated value. Conversely, human-language value + generic affective visual + psychology label may all project relevance while losing the musical category.\n\n## 8. Title/thumbnail relationship\n\nThe two surfaces should divide labor rather than duplicate slogans.\n\n- The **title** can carry proposition, object, causal gap, experiential precision, or session promise.\n- The **thumbnail** should support fast classification with one hinge, one relation, or one product-native proof—not a second dense argument.\n- If the title is human-value-forward, the thumbnail should usually strengthen work/time/method classification.\n- If the thumbnail is method-forward, the title should usually state substantive work-bound value so the product does not look like software.\n- If the work identity is inherently strong for the target audience, it may carry more of the classification load; do not assume this for cold or classical-identity-low audiences.\n\n## 9. Effort calibration\n\nGuided Full’s density is not a defect to conceal and not a prestige feature to glorify. Package signals should let the right people anticipate a synchronized reading/listening experience.\n\nValid effort signals can include duration, progress/timeline cues, visible synchronized text, “full work/session” semantics, or editorial seriousness. Invalid effort signaling includes exclusivity, “for serious listeners only,” status-coded difficulty, or false simplification.\n\n## 10. Aggressive strategy admissibility\n\nA strategy is **aggressive** when its strongest attractor comes from an adjacent category or a highly portable human reward. Aggressive does not mean forbidden.\n\n### Gate A — Attracted motive can be high-fit\n\nState why someone attracted by the hook could genuinely value Guided Full after entry. For F03/A03b, for example, recognition can be high-fit when it increases attention to the music, tolerates non-identity with the interpretation, and creates a cross-work return reason. For F03/A03d, human-process interest can be high-fit when the process is observed *through* music-time rather than consumed as a standalone thesis. For F04, method curiosity can be high-fit when novelty converts to substantive work use.\n\n### Gate B — First-contact currency matches\n\nThe first product moments must pay the promised reward in the same currency. A recognition hook cannot open into abstract musicology; a method hook cannot open into a feature tour; a WHY-NOW hook cannot open into static labels.\n\n### Gate C — Adjacent-category boundary is recoverable\n\nThe combined package must let a reasonable viewer distinguish the product from therapy, wellness, theory course, fixed story, biography, quote content, or software demo before mismatch compounds.\n\n### Gate D — Return locus is healthy\n\nSpecify what a satisfied entrant wants next. If the answer is “another topic like grief,” “another quote that says me,” “another UI trick,” or “an easier course,” the strategy has not yet demonstrated product-level fit.\n\n### Gate E — Long-term identity is acceptable\n\nProject the effect of 20–50 repetitions. If the likely learned category is one the product cannot fulfill, do not scale even if local performance is strong.\n\n## 11. Causal rejection contract\n",

[L2]   "content": "# IDENTICAL GENERATOR PROMPT — Op.52 入口包 Generator\n\n你是多个完全独立 Generator 之一。\n\n你收到：\n- 真实 Op.52 Guided Full\n- frozen Entry Strategy v2\n- current final visual evidence\n\n不要看其他 Generator 的答案。\n\n## A. 先看 Op.52 自己\n读完整 23/80 viewer-facing content，并检查当前 final video/frames。\n\n提取：\n- 最有辨识度的变化\n- 最独特的 WHY_NOW\n- 最可能形成跨圈层 relevance 的人类经验\n- 必须依赖真实音乐时间的价值\n- 不适合入口的精彩局部\n- 放进 title 会过度总括的局部句子\n\n不改 Canonical。\n\n## B. 判断 F01–F05 在 Op.52 上的适用性\n逐一给：\n- HIGHLY_PROMISING\n- PROMISING\n- CONDITIONAL\n- WEAK_FOR_OP52\n\n不要 numeric score。\n\n每个判断都写：\n- Op.52 evidence\n- audience motive\n- attraction mechanism\n- false positive / valuable false negative\n- first-contact fulfillment\n- long-term channel effect\n\n## C. 实际生成候选\n只对真正有竞争力的路径生成。\n不要每 family 凑一个。\n\n每个 candidate 必须包含：\n- family / aperture\n- audience motive\n- actual Chinese `title_text`\n- actual Chinese `thumbnail_text`\n- concrete thumbnail visual\n- title/thumbnail information division\n- attract / repel / FP / FN\n- expected click motive\n- expected entry expectation\n- first-contact fulfillment\n- post-entry fit\n- 20–50 release channel effect\n\n## D. Title 规则\n必须是真实可发布中文，不是 placeholder。\n\n允许强 hook，但禁止：\n- 假剧情\n- 假作者意图\n- “真正的含义”\n- “你一直听错”\n- 心理诊断\n- 纯鸡汤\n- 局部解释冒充整首作品唯一真理\n\n## E. Thumbnail 规则\n必须真正考虑推荐页缩略图。\n\n写：\n- first_glance_category\n- focal_object\n- composition\n- text hierarchy\n- series_fixed\n- op52_variable\n- portrait use?\n- score use?\n- UI visual DNA use?\n- metaphor use?\n- negative constraints\n\nGuided Full 一屏小字不能直接当最终封面。\n\n## F. 自我攻击\n对每套 candidate：\n\n1. strongest case\n2. strongest attack\n3. KEEP / REVISE / DROP\n4. 只有 KEEP/REVISE 版本进入最终输出\n\n## G. 输出\n- `FAMILY_APPLICABILITY.md`\n- `CANDIDATES.md`\n- `CANDIDATES.json`\n\n---\n\n## 附件结构说明（WAVE1_SOURCE_PACK.zip）\n\n- `SOURCE_PROVENANCE.md` —— 全部证据哈希与硬规则（先读）\n- `content/GUIDED_FULL_CONTENT.zh-CN.json` —— 唯一权威中文正文（恰好 23 个时间单元 / 80 条 atom）\n- `content/FINAL_CANONICAL.zip`、`FINAL_CANONICAL.meta.json` —— canonical 包与其元数据\n- `content/ZH_CALIBRATION_FINAL_REPORT.md` —— 中文校准终报\n- `presentation/PRESENTATION_V3_FROZEN_DECISIONS.md` 等 —— 当前产品冻结决策、最终渲染报告、渲染清单\n- `visual/contact_sheet.png` 与 6 张代表帧 —— 唯一最终渲染 MP4 的机械抽帧导数；你必须逐张查看这些图片\n- `entry_strategy_frozen/` —— 冻结 Entry Strategy v2：十件套 canonical 文件 + 审计记录 + SHA 清单\n\n## 输出方式\n\n把 G 部分三份交付物（`FAMILY_APPLICABILITY.md`、`CANDIDATES.md`、`CANDIDATES.json`）\n完整写在你的最终回复里：Markdown 文件用 fenced code block，JSON 用 ```json fenced block。\n所有面向人的文字自然中文优先；英文术语第一次出现时用中文解释。\nCANDIDATES.json 必须是可直接解析的单个 JSON 对象（顶层键建议：\n`candidates` 数组 + 每项含 prompt 中 C 节要求的全部字段）。",

对，我现在把这条链从 **我们最初的 packaging ontology → Entry Strategy v2 → 实际 Generator → Final Selector** 重新顺着看了一遍，问题已经可以比较准确地定位了。

**不是 GPT 没做好，而是我们的后续提示词把一个本来还算正确的 ontology，逐步推成了一套“学术上非常自洽、传播上非常奇怪”的目标函数。** 最终这些标题其实是在严格执行我们的错误 contract。

最关键的反差在这里。

最早那轮 ontology 的结论其实相当正常：它说标题首先是**作品身份 / 检索 + 必要的产品模式承诺**，不是小论文、不是剧情、不是作品的“情绪本质”；局部 entry aperture 最多只应该作为**有边界、待测试的实验**。它甚至明确说：问题句只有在帮助检索或减少品类误解时才有理论依据，纯粹拿 curiosity hook 换点击并不成立。封面也被定义成“快速分类 / 识别 / 注意力 surface”，而不是解释。fileciteturn36file0L2-L2

**真正开始歪的是下一包 `guided-entry-strategy-v2`。**

它开头直接把上一轮 ontology 降级成：

> `PRIOR theory, never policy`

而且明确说，要覆盖掉之前偏保守的倾向。然后它建立了 F01/F02/F03 这些 acquisition families，其中直接规定：

- F01 标题 = `[piece] + [one specific hearable change] + [series]`
- F02 标题 = `[piece] + [temporal causal hinge] + [model id]`
- F02 缩略图 = 一个 `X → ? → Y` 的 causal gap
- F03 标题 = `[piece-grounded human tension] + [piece] + [listening-model id]`
- click motive 被写成了 `"我漏听了什么？"`、`"为什么偏偏现在"`、`"这说中了"`。fileciteturn37file0L2-L2

于是事情已经被**预制**了。

你现在看到的：

> `肖邦《第四叙事曲》开头：为什么还没进入悲痛，声音却先稳住了？｜Op.52 全曲同步引导`

几乎可以逐词反推 prompt：

```text
肖邦《第四叙事曲》
↑
object truth / piece identity

开头
↑
bounded local aperture
防止 false totalization

为什么……却……
↑
F02 bounded causal gap
WHY-NOW acquisition mechanism

全曲同步引导
↑
time/method truth + whole-work truth
```

**这不是模型偶然写出一个怪标题。是我们的 contract 正好要求它写成这样。**

甚至 Entry Package Design Contract 自己就明确规定 F02 的 Title job 是：

> “create a bounded causal gap”

Thumbnail job 又是：

> “show a before→now or return-with-memory relation”

所以最后出来 `稳住 → 回看` 这种图解文字完全是按设计来的。fileciteturn38file0L2-L2

---

更致命的是，到了实际 Generator prompt，我们又只写了：

> “必须是真实可发布中文”  
> “允许强 hook”

然后主要列了一堆**禁止骗人**的规则：不能假剧情、不能假作者意图、不能心理诊断、不能局部冒充整首……fileciteturn40file0L2-L2

但我们没有给它一个同等强度的**正面传播标准**。

没有真正要求：

> 一个完全不知道我们内部 ontology 的人在首页刷到这句话，**一秒钟能不能明白为什么它值得点？**

没有要求：

> 这句话像不像一个活人真正会说、会转发、会产生欲望的标题，而不是一个研究问题？

没有要求：

> 去掉我们已经知道的 23/80 内容以后，这个 hook 自己还有没有吸引力？

没有要求：

> “声音先稳住”这种概念，对尚未听见这个开头的人来说到底有没有意义？

所以我们做了一个非常典型的错误：

> **把“听完解释以后觉得这个观察很妙”误当成“听之前就会想点进去”。**

这两者完全不是一回事。

---

## Final Selector 又把这个错误放大了

它选择 PRIMARY 的核心理由居然是：

> 这个 hook 在 `GF-U001` 就开始兑现，所以“主钩兑现路径最短”。

它还写：

> “真实吸引力足够高”

但这里实际上没有真实冷启动点击实验来证明“吸引力足够高”。这是模型基于 audience motive 推断出来的。fileciteturn45file0L2-L2

也就是说，我们实际上算的是：

```text
假设有人已经觉得
“为什么声音先稳住”
这件事很有意思

那么他点进来以后：
很快得到兑现 ✓
内容很匹配 ✓
不会被骗 ✓
长期频道定位健康 ✓
```

这个推导本身没错。

问题在最前面：

> **“有人为什么会先觉得这件事有意思？”**

我们根本没有证明。

传播最关键的第一个乘数被跳过去了。

所以 Selector 在优化：

```text
P(fit | click)
```

但我们真正需要的是类似：

```text
P(stop)
×
P(click | right audience)
×
P(expectation match)
×
P(stay/listen | click)
```

现在前两个基本是理论推演，后两个倒研究得极其认真。

这就出现了：

> **高度 qualified，但没人想点。**

---

## 还有一个特别大的 evaluator contamination

我们所有 Generator、Reviewer、Judge 都看了：

- 完整 23/80 Canonical
- Guided Full
- Entry Strategy
- audience causal ledger
- WHY_NOW
- rationale
- 作品全过程。

所以他们看到：

> “还没进入悲痛，声音却先稳住了”

会立刻知道这句话背后有什么。

在他们脑中：

```text
这句话
→ opening temporal position
→ self-settling
→ before memory truly opens
→ 后面 U002 的回看
→ 一整条 WHY-NOW relation
```

所以他们觉得：

> “卧槽，这个 hook 很精确。”

可首页路人只有：

```text
“声音却先稳住了？”
```

他的第一反应完全可能是：

> **啊？你在说啥？**

我们没有做真正的 **cold blind evaluation**。

真正应该有一批 Judge：

> **绝对不给他们 Canonical、不给策略解释、不给 candidate rationale。**

只给他看：

```text
标题
+
实际 160/320px 封面
+
模拟 YouTube/B站首页环境
```

然后问：

```text
1. 你认为这是什么视频？
2. 你第一眼理解它会给你什么？
3. 哪个东西让你想点？
4. 有什么词需要先理解作者的理论才能成立？
5. 你预期点进去看到什么？
6. 如果不点，为什么？
```

这才模拟真正的 entry state。

我们之前的 Judge 全都是**知情评委**。

这在内容 Judge 上很好，在传播 Judge 上反而会严重失真。

---

## 还有一个架构顺序错误：我们把“平台 realization”错误地叫成了 micro-tuning

`Entry Strategy v2` 自己明确把：

- title character/truncation
- search vocabulary
- thumbnail display
- autoplay exposure
- CTR elasticity
- platform A/B

都延后，称为 platform implementation，而不让它们参与 strategy 决策。fileciteturn37file0L2-L2

然后下一轮我们却已经生成并冻结了**精确到每一个汉字的正式 title**。

最后 report 一边写：

> `Primary title = ...`

一边又说：

> “没有做 YouTube/B站最终平台微调。”fileciteturn33file0L7-L7

这其实自相矛盾。

对于：

> abstract entry strategy

平台细节确实是 implementation。

但一旦进入：

> **实际标题文案**

平台语言根本不是“微调”。

YouTube 标题和 B站标题怎么说话、首页怎样截断、搜索与推荐页怎么理解、同类内容在用户脑中建立什么 language prior——这些已经直接构成 title 本身。

所以我们错误地做成了：

```text
ontology
↓
entry strategy
↓
精确 title
↓
精确 thumbnail
↓
最后再 platform tuning
```

应该是：

```text
ontology
↓
entry strategy
↓
platform-native realization context
↓
精确 title + thumbnail candidates
↓
cold-feed evaluation
↓
再 freeze
```

---

## 所以问题不是一个点，是三个连续的 overcorrection

### 第一层：本来正确

Packaging ontology：

> 不骗人，不提前把作品压成一个 thesis；标题和封面各有职责。

这个我觉得基本可以保留。

### 第二层：开始过头

Entry Strategy：

> 不要太保守，要主动找 audience acquisition reward。

于是把：

> **“局部 aperture 可以测试”**

升级成：

> **“每首作品应该找一个具体 perceptual / WHY-NOW / human tension 作为入口 family。”**

这一步太激进。

### 第三层：真正坏掉

Actual Generator / Selector：

> 从这些 family 里生成“强 hook”，再按 audience fit、first-contact fulfillment、FP/FN、长期 identity 选冠军。

但没有一个同等一级的：

> **COLD DESIRE / FEED NATIVENESS**

评价轴。

所以 8 个 Generator + 5 轮 Reviewer/Judge 并没有救我们。

他们只是**把错误 objective 收敛得更彻底了**。

---

我甚至会把这个问题压成一句：

> **我们把传播学做成了“如何保证一个聪明的钩子不骗人”，却没有真正研究“这个钩子为什么会让一个冷观众产生欲望”。**

封面也是同一个病：

> 如何让 relation 精确、不误读

研究得很多；

> 为什么一个人刷过去会停

研究得不够。

所以才同时得到：

```text
学术问题式标题
+
抽象 causal diagram 封面
```

它们非常一致。

也非常不适合真正传播。

---

### 接下来我认为不用推翻前面的所有研究

**保留：**

- Guided Full 本体；
- false-totalization guard；
- 不假剧情；
- whole-work truth；
- audience mismatch / FP / FN；
- title + thumbnail 不应该机械重复；
- pre/post-roll 的 ontology。

**直接宣布需要重新校准的：**

- `Entry Strategy v2` 里的 title/thumbnail family skeleton；
- Actual Generator 的 D/E 两节；
- Candidate Reviewer/Judge rubric；
- Final Selector objective；
- Image Director / Image Judge。

尤其要新增一个第一等质量轴：

> **COLD QUALIFIED DESIRE**

它不是 raw CTR，也不是 clickbait。

它问：

> 一个对此作品可能有兴趣、但完全不知道我们内部解释的人，看到这个东西以后，是否**立刻理解价值，而且真的产生进入欲望**？

然后再乘：

> promise fidelity。

而不是现在只有后者。

我觉得这次人工看 PDF 暴露得非常好：**不是三张封面不好看、三个标题措辞要润色，而是整个 entry-generation evaluation layer 的 objective function 有一个根本缺项。**这值得直接做一次 prompt-system calibration，而不是让 Agent 把“声音却先稳住了”改成更顺口一点就继续。

Audience mix：扩张发生在能力/兴趣邻接，而不是类别借贷\n\nCU-014 的组合是 `A02 + A06 + A07 + A10`。A02 是产品原生的因果系统型；A06 把 close-reading 能力跨域迁入；A07 把器乐/跨流派经验迁入；A10 保证开放模型、非 verdict 的 epistemic fit。这个组合既不只守住古典核心，也不需要用“不懂乐理”“疗愈/安心”“励志力量”或 interface novelty 作为首要入口。\n\n因此它牺牲了一些更显著或更专门的 audience——A17 coda/score、A08 competence-insecure、A05/A16 felt tracking、A11 ritual——但换来的是更健康的默认 audience prior：**来这里是为了在作品进行时听清“为什么现在这样”**。\n\n### 3. 误卖：风险存在，但边界可恢复\n\nCU-014 的主要 FP 是把“为什么”读成和声/作曲家意图，或把“先稳住”读成心理建议。两类风险都可以被作品名、开头范围、真实 time-path、冻结双轴与“不用固定剧情”的产品边界恢复。\n\n相比之下，CU-015 的 `力量 ≠ 胜利` 自带更高的励志/反常识/尾声剪辑 prior；CU-022 的“不用先懂乐理”自带 beginner/easy/remedial prior，且必须 sunset；CU-021 的安宁/变紧更容易借到 wellness/slow-attention prior；CU-016 更容易借到 tech-demo prior。它们都值得测试，但不如 CU-014 适合当默认频道承诺。\n\n### 4. 长期 identity：可重复的是问题类型，不是题材\n\n健康的 20–50 release 身份不是“肖邦心理解读”或“古典名曲揭秘”，而是：**作品绑定、全曲同步、在音乐时间里追问 WHY-NOW，并允许模型被听众测试和不同意。** CU-014 最容易把这个身份直接教给新 理解成四个不同的非支配方向：\n\n- **CU-014 / OP52-C01 — 默认平衡点：** 最快具体兑现 + 广而高-fit 的 WHY-NOW audience + 低类别债。\n- **CU-015 / C10_POWER_NOT_VICTORY — 最大 perceptual salience / coda-crossgenre 上行：** 更强第一眼悖论，但主证据晚、FP ### Assistant — 2026-08-26T18:18:44.277Z

*We can’t afford this kind of wasted time in the middle of development. Maybe the right process is to get a rough but real version in front of us first, and make everything after that an incremental refinement rather than a rediscovery of the direction.*

对。**这次真正暴露出来的，不只是 entry prompt 写错了，而是我们的开发顺序本身不适合这种高度主观、必须“看到东西才知道对不对”的产品。**

我会把原则改成：

> **先得到一个“已经像最终产品”的低成本雏形；后续研究、agent、review、judge 的职责主要是解释它、攻击它、补它、优化它，而不是在几十小时后才第一次把抽象理论变成可见成品。**

这里的“雏形”不是 markdown 里的 strategy，也不是一堆 title skeleton。必须是**用户真正会接触到的那个形态**。

对标题/封面来说，最早一轮就应该看到：

- 3–6 个**真实中文标题**；
- 每个配一个**非常粗但已经按真实比例排出来的封面**；
- 放进模拟的 YouTube/B站首页尺寸里；
- 最好连最终 Guided Full 的首帧/前几十秒也放旁边；
- 不需要精致生成图片，不需要 8×Agent convergence，不需要 Reviewer/Judge 十轮。

然后我们先问最粗暴的几个问题：

> 我看到它想点吗？  
> 我一眼知道这是什么吗？  
> 它哪里怪？  
> 它是不是像某种“研究项目包装”？  
> 它承诺的东西，我真的在视频里想获得吗？

**这关不过，后面一分钱成本都不应该继续投。**

这次恰恰反了。我们大概是：

```text
ontology
→ 8 agent research
→ canonicalize
→ reviewer/judge convergence
→ audience strategy
→ 8 generator
→ 5轮 convergence
→ selector
→ 12 image directors
→ 24张真实图
→ image reviewer/judge
→ 最后看到 PDF
→ “这标题和封面怎么这么怪？”
```

真正合理的应该更像：

```text
少量产品理解
↓
立即做 3–6 个真实 entry 雏形
↓
人直接看 + cold blind 看
↓
方向不对：立刻重做，成本极低
↓
方向大致对：冻结“形”
↓
再让多个 Agent 研究：
为什么它有效 / 哪里漏 audience / 有什么风险 / 怎样做得更好
↓
Reviewer/Judge 只在这个可见形态附近竞争
↓
高保真实现
↓
最终人看
```

这里有一个很重要的词：**vertical slice（纵向切片）**。

我们以后不应该先把一个层面研究到 95 分，再进入下一个层面。而应该尽早把整个链条各做一点，让我们先看到：

> **如果今天必须发布，它大概长什么样。**

比如这次 entry，第一天就应该出现这样一个文件夹：

```text
ROUGH_ENTRY_V0/
  candidate_01/
    title.txt
    thumbnail_rough.png
    feed_preview.png

  candidate_02/
    ...

  candidate_03/
    ...
```

哪怕封面只是 PPT/PIL 画的文字+几何块，都行。

因为我们这次真正需要判断的不是像素质量，而是：

> `“稳住 → 回看” + “为什么还没进入悲痛……”`

**这个东西整体看起来究竟像不像一个值得点的视频。**

这根本不需要生成 24 张图片才能发现。

---

而且你说的“**后面的只是在这上面加**”我觉得可以进一步写成开发硬约束：

> **任何昂贵阶段，都必须以前一阶段已有一个可感知的 end-user artifact 为前提。**

后续工作只能有三类：

**加**：增加前面雏形确实缺少的能力。

**减**：删掉雏形里显得多余、碍事、误导的东西。

**精炼**：把已经成立的结构做得更准确、更漂亮、更鲁棒。

而不应该出现：

> 做了二十小时抽象研究以后，第一次 realization 才告诉我们“哦，原来整个方向看起来就不对”。

如果后期真的发现结构级错误，也不是禁止改；而是应该被标成：

> **STRUCTURAL REOPEN**

然后明确承认此前 gate 失败了，回到雏形阶段。

这样至少我们不会把结构性探索伪装成“继续优化”。

---

我们现在这套多 Agent 方法也应该随之改变。

**多 Agent 不是越早越好。**

早期最大的价值其实是**快速扩大形态空间**：

> 8 个 Agent 各自直接做一套粗成品。

而不是：

> 8 个 Agent 各写 50 KB 理论报告 → canonicalize → 再由后面的 agent 把理论变成东西。

前者我们十几分钟就可以看出：

- 这一路像教育视频；
- 那一路像心理学账号；
- 这一路很学术；
- 那一路反而有传播感；
- 某个意外方向特别好。

**先看到 output distribution，再研究为什么。**

这跟我们 Canonical 内容开发还不完全一样。Canonical 是语义完整性问题，深 Reviewer/Judge 很有意义；但 title/thumbnail 这种**最终判断高度依赖 gestalt（整体第一印象）**的东西，artifact 必须比理论先出现。

所以我现在会给整个项目定一个总原则：

> **高成本收敛只能发生在“我们已经见过它”的东西上。**

甚至更严格：

> **Never converge an abstraction that has not yet been rendered into the user’s actual decision surface.**  
> 不要对一个还没变成用户实际看到的东西的抽象概念进行昂贵收敛。

这次 entry 的几十小时，最大的教训就是这个。我们以后按这个原则搞，很多这种返工可以在第一个小时暴露，而不是最后一个小时。memcite

### Assistant — 2026-08-26T18:55:42.019Z

*Eight agents aren’t the bottleneck; sequential judge/reviewer layers are. So the next step should be to produce something we can actually look at immediately, and use later work only to refine that visible artifact rather than repeatedly re-derive the strategy.*

对，我觉得现在应该把流程砍得非常短。**8 个 Agent 可以继续全开，甚至 8 个非常合适；真正要禁止的是 `Generator → Reviewer → Judge → Reviewer → Judge...` 这种串行收敛。**

接下来我建议不要再研究 ontology，也不要先修旧的 Entry Strategy。**直接做一个新的 `ROUGH ENTRY V0`。**目标不是“得到最终标题”，而是**半小时到一小时后我们就能看到这支视频如果今天发布，大概长什么样。**

### 第一阶段：8 个 Agent 同时产“完整雏形”，不是报告

8 个 Agent 完全相同 prompt、彼此独立。每个只需要产 **2–3 套完整 package**，所以最后大约 16–24 套。每套必须是一个真实可看的东西，而不是 strategy family：

```text
PACKAGE
├── actual YouTube/B站中文标题
├── actual thumbnail text（允许 NONE）
├── concrete thumbnail visual direction
├── rough thumbnail
├── YouTube feed mockup
├── B站 feed mockup
└── 1–2 句：
    这个东西第一眼为什么可能让人想点
```

**不要让 Agent 写 40KB audience theory。**

它只需要读：

- 当前 Guided Full 最终成品/代表帧；
- Op.52 最终内容；
- 极短的 hard constraints。

Hard constraints 只保留真正不能违反的：

- 是肖邦《第四叙事曲》这支完整 Guided Full；
- 不能骗人；
- 不能把局部解释冒充全曲唯一含义；
- 不能让人误以为是心理治疗、乐理课、软件 demo 等完全错误品类；
- 点进去以后必须基本兑现入口承诺。

**把 F01/F02/F03、`bounded causal gap`、`WHY-NOW title skeleton`、`X→Y thumbnail` 这些全部从 Generator 输入里拿掉。**

否则又会把答案预制成现在这样。

---

### 最关键的产物不是 JSON，而是一张“大板”

主 Agent 收完 8 个 Agent 后，不做 Reviewer。

只做 clerical 去重，然后立刻生成一个：

> **`OP52_ENTRY_ROUGH_V0_REVIEW.pdf`**

这才是这一阶段真正的 deliverable。

我希望 PDF 大概 8–12 页。

第一页就是 **所有候选的 feed wall**，类似真的刷 YouTube/B站：

```text
┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐
│ thumbnail│  │ thumbnail│  │ thumbnail│
│          │  │          │  │          │
└──────────┘  └──────────┘  └──────────┘
title...       title...       title...
channel...     channel...     channel...

┌──────────┐  ...
```

我们第一眼就能看到：

> 哪些根本不像会有人点。  
> 哪些像知识区烂标题。  
> 哪些像 AI 心理学。  
> 哪些太正经。  
> 哪些突然有东西。

之后每页放 3–4 套，放大一点。

**不要在第一页告诉我哪个 Agent、哪个 family、它的 rationale 是什么。**

否则我们也会被解释污染。

---

### 第二阶段才需要 Judge，而且只要“一层”

这一步我会保留 8 个 Judge，但**全部并行**。

也就是说时间结构不是：

```text
Judge 1
↓
Reviewer
↓
Judge 2
↓
Reviewer
↓
Judge 3
```

而是：

```text
        J1
        J2
        J3
候选 →  J4   同时
        J5
        J6
        J7
        J8
```

**只有一层。**

而且这些应该是真正的 **cold judges**。

他们绝对不要看到：

- Canonical；
- WHY_NOW；
- Entry Strategy；
- candidate rationale；
- audience model；
- 哪个是旧 winner。

只给：

> 模拟首页里的实际 title + actual rough thumbnail。

然后每个人回答的也不要复杂：

1. **第一眼你觉得这是什么视频？**
2. **你觉得点进去能得到什么？**
3. **你有没有真实的点击欲望？为什么？**
4. **如果不点，第一障碍是什么？**
5. **有什么地方像“作者自己觉得很聪明，但陌生人不知道在说什么”？**
6. **有没有错误品类感？**
7. **你最愿意点哪 3 个？**
8. **哪几个绝对不应该继续投入制作成本？**

这时候 8 个 Judge 的价值是**覆盖不同第一反应**，而不是构成八层审批。

---

## 然后就停，给你看

这个节点不要让 Agent 自动继续。

交给你的东西应该只有三个核心文件：

```text
OP52_ENTRY_ROUGH_V0_REVIEW.pdf
COLD_JUDGE_SUMMARY.md
CANDIDATES.json
```

其中你实际上只需要先看 PDF。

Judge summary 只作为旁证：

> “8 个冷评委里 6 个都说这个像心理学视频。”

而不是告诉你：

> “模型已经选好了 winner。”

---

# 你看完之后，我们才进入第二轮“在这上面加”

这里才体现你刚才那句话。

假设你看了 20 套后说：

> 03 有意思，但图太俗。  
> 07 的标题方向对，但后半句废话。  
> 11 第一眼最好，但别做得像心理号。  
> 旧 PRIMARY 全扔。

那么下一轮就不是重新研究世界。

而是把：

> **03 / 07 / 11**

作为 visible seeds。

再开 8 Agent，同样并行，让他们全部围绕这几个 seed 做**局部变体**：

```text
保留什么
删什么
标题怎么更自然
封面视觉锚点怎么更强
YouTube版
B站版
```

产出例如 12 个 refined package。

再做一次 feed PDF。

到这里可能就已经可以选了。

---

# 所以我会把 judge 层数硬限制成最多两次

整个 entry 开发：

```text
ROUND 0
8 Generator
↓
真实粗 package
↓
PDF
↓
8 cold judges（1 层）
↓
你看

ROUND 1
8 Refiner
只围绕你保留的方向
↓
高一点保真度 package
↓
PDF
↓
必要时 8 cold judges（最多再 1 层）
↓
你选

PRODUCTION
↓
真正生成高清封面
↓
平台精确 title
↓
最终发布 QA
```

**没有 Reviewer/Judge convergence loop。**

如果第二轮之后还没有一个你觉得“方向明显对”的东西：

> 不继续 Judge。

直接说明探索空间还没找到，重新 Generator。

因为再 Judge 十轮也不会把一个没有生命力的方向审成有生命力。

---

# 这一次 Rough V0 应该故意扩大“形态空间”

还有一点特别重要。

8 个 Generator 虽然 prompt 相同，但应该要求它们：

> **不要只给“最严谨”的方案，要给 materially different 的真实传播尝试。**

例如它们可以自然探索：

- 作品本身作为吸引物；
- 演奏/肖邦身份；
- 一个真正有普遍直觉力量的问题；
- Guided Full 本身这个奇特产品；
- “第一次有人这样陪你听完整首”的体验；
- 历史/录音/作品身份；
- 某个特别强但不虚假的音乐现象；
- 极简 prestige；
- 更偏 B站原生的话语；
- 更偏 YouTube search/browse 的话语。

**但不要我们提前规定成 10 个 family。**

让 8 个 Agent 自己扩。

我们只看它们到底产出了什么。

---

## 封面 V0 也不要再花大钱

这一阶段甚至不需要 24 次 image generation。

每个候选先用**粗视觉拼贴 / deterministic mockup**就够了：

- 肖邦肖像；
- 真实乐谱；
- 当前 Guided Full frame；
- 钢琴/演奏视觉；
- 大字；
- 裁切；
- 明暗；
- 非具象图像；
- 留白。

只要足够回答：

> **这种 visual ontology 第一眼成立不成立？**

如果某套进入第二轮，再真的用 image model 做漂亮版本。

这样不会再发生：

> 先生 24 张高清抽象图，最后才发现我们根本不想要抽象图。

---

# 我认为现在让 Agent 产出的“东西”，最核心就一句

> **不是研究报告，而是 16–24 个可以直接放进真实推荐页里看的“标题 + 粗封面”的完整雏形，以及一份把它们全部放在同一视觉环境里的 PDF。**

这是当前最需要的东西。

我们的下一次人工判断应该发生在**第一批 Generator 之后**，而不是十几个自动阶段之后。

只要其中出现两三个让你第一眼觉得：

> “对，大概是这个方向。”

后面所有 Agent 才值得继续围着它加。memcite

### Assistant — 2026-08-26T18:57:02.029Z

有，而且现在这条链里其实有**两层容易都被叫成“归一”**：

1. **Generator 后的 clerical normalization**
   - 8 个 Generator 各自产候选；
   - 主 Agent 把它们的实际输出统一字段、去掉格式差异、保留原始 title/thumbnail 文案；
   - 形成 `wave1/CANDIDATE_LEDGER.json`。
   - 这一层本质上只是**整理/登记/去重准备**，不应该做创意判断。当前 v2 就是把 8 个 Generator 的 29 个候选先整理成 ledger。fileciteturn33file0L7-L7

2. **后面的 C0 Candidate Universe Canonicalizer**
   - 它不是纯整理，而是真正开始做**语义合并、去重、Pareto 收敛**；
   - 当前流程里 29 个候选经它收成了 19 个 Pareto-relevant entries，然后才继续 Reviewer / Judge。fileciteturn33file0L7-L7

所以现在大致是：

```text
8 Generators
↓
clerical normalization
CANDIDATE_LEDGER
↓
C0 Candidate Universe Canonicalizer
↓
Reviewer / Judge ...
```

而我现在建议改成：

```text
8 Generators
↓
clerical normalization
只做字段统一 + exact dedupe
↓
立刻做 rough feed PDF
↓
你看 / cold judges
```

**先不要跑 C0 Canonicalizer。**

因为 C0 一旦开始“把 29 个候选收成 19 个 Pareto universe”，它已经在替我们做方向判断了。现在我们最需要的是**先看到原始创意空间长什么样**，避免还没见到东西就被一次抽象收敛提前剪枝。

所以这个“归一层”我会保留，但只保留**机械归一**：

- 同字段；
- 同命名；
- exact/near-duplicate 标记；
- 来源追踪；
- 不改标题；
- 不改封面概念；
- 不合并两个“意思差不多”的方案；
- 不做 Pareto elimination。

然后直接把 16–24 个候选全摆到 PDF 里给你看。

这个改动其实很小，但能把我们第一次看到真实形态的时间提前很多。memcite

### Assistant — 2026-08-26T18:59:11.361Z

*I’m wondering whether the reviewer is simply being asked to absorb too much at once, which may be one reason we ended up needing so many sequential review layers. Could we trade depth for parallelism—for example, have Reviewer A look only at the outputs of two generators, then combine those local reviews later?*

对，**这个方向非常值得做，而且我觉得比“一个 Reviewer 吃掉 8 个 Generator，再 Reviewer/Judge 循环五轮”更适合我们现在这种任务。**

但先区分一下：这次之所以有五轮，不完全是 Reviewer “看不过来”。当前流程是 **8 Generator → 29 candidates → C0 收成 19 → Reviewer/Judge 连续 5 轮**；协议本身就规定“只要还有 material gain 就继续”，所以多层首先是**架构造成的**。不过，让一个 Reviewer 同时比较十几二十个候选、还要记 audience、FP/FN、长期 identity、作品证据，确实会增加认知负担，也很容易让它依赖已有 taxonomy，而不是凭实际成品判断。fileciteturn33file0L7-L7

我建议我们明确采取一个原则：

> **用更多并行 Agent 换更少的串行深度。**

而且你说的“2 个 Generator 给一个 Reviewer”正好可以做成很稳的结构。

### 我最推荐的结构

```text
8 Generators
同时
G1 G2 G3 G4 G5 G6 G7 G8
│  │  │  │  │  │  │  │
└┬─┘  └┬─┘  └┬─┘  └┬─┘
 R1     R2     R3     R4
（4个 Reviewer 并行）
          ↓
     survivors union
          ↓
      ROUGH PDF
          ↓
        你看
```

这意味着第一次见到成品前，**只有一层串行 review**。

而且 R1 不应该“从 G1/G2 选一个冠军”，而应该做 **local frontier reduction**：

- 只看两个 Generator；
- 大概 4–6 套真实 package；
- 去掉明显差的、重复的；
- **保留 materially different 的 2–4 套**；
- 不替它们重写成一个“综合最佳方案”。

这样 20 套粗候选可能压成 8–12 套，然后马上给你看。

---

### 还可以利用“Agent 数量不是问题”增加鲁棒性，而不增加层数

单纯 `G1+G2 → R1` 有一个风险：R1 如果判断失误，一个好方向可能在第一层直接死掉。

解决办法不是再加第二轮，而是**增加同一层的横向覆盖**。

比如开 8 个 Reviewer：

```text
R1: G1 + G2
R2: G2 + G3
R3: G3 + G4
R4: G4 + G5
R5: G5 + G6
R6: G6 + G7
R7: G7 + G8
R8: G8 + G1
```

全部同时跑。

这样每个 Generator 被**两个独立 Reviewer**看过。

规则：

> 一个 candidate 只要被任意一个 Reviewer 判为 KEEP，就进入下一步。

所以我们获得了 reviewer redundancy，却没有增加任何时间深度。

这其实特别符合你说的资源结构：

```text
宽度便宜
深度昂贵
```

那就应该尽量：

> **横着堆模型，不要竖着堆模型。**

---

## 更重要的是：Reviewer 不应该再承担“重新发明”

当前 Reviewer/Judge loop 会不断返回 revised challenger，所以每一轮实际上都可能：

> 重新合并 → 重写 → 补 strategy → 再 Judge。

这自然会把层数拉长。

新的 Pair Reviewer 应该职责非常窄：

> **淘汰明显失败 + 保住不同方向 + 做很小的局部修复建议。**

输出类似：

```text
G1-C1 — KEEP
理由：第一眼价值清楚，封面方向成立

G1-C2 — DROP
理由：冷观众不知道“撤销”指什么

G2-C1 — KEEP
理由：完全不同的 work-first 路线，不能和 G1-C1 合并

G2-C2 — REVISE
问题：标题后半句像课程名
只建议删除，不生成全新 concept
```

它**不需要构造新的 canonical universe**。

---

## 然后我甚至建议第一次不再有 Global Reviewer

这点很关键。

原来可能会想：

```text
4 Pair Reviewers
↓
Global Reviewer
↓
Judge
↓
Human
```

我觉得还是多余。

第一次应该：

```text
8 Generators
↓
8 overlapping Pair Reviewers
一层
↓
机械 union / exact dedupe
↓
PDF
↓
你
```

也就是说，**第一次 visible prototype 前只有一层模型深度。**

你看完以后说：

> A、C、F 方向值得继续。

我们再启动下一轮。

---

## 第二轮也同样保持浅层

例如你留下 3 个方向：

```text
Seed A
Seed C
Seed F
```

再开 8 个 Refiner，同样并行，每个围绕这些 seed 做真实变体。

然后可以有**一层 cold judge**：

```text
8 Refiner
↓
8 cold judges simultaneously
↓
机械汇总
↓
PDF
↓
你选
```

不要再：

```text
Reviewer
↓
Judge
↓
Reviewer
↓
Judge
...
```

---

### 所以整个系统的时间深度可以固定成

**V0 探索：**

```text
Generator
↓
Pair Reviewer
↓
Human
```

**V1 精炼：**

```text
Refiner
↓
Cold Judge
↓
Human
```

**Production：**

```text
high-fidelity realization
↓
QA
```

这就非常浅了。

---

还有一点我觉得非常重要：**归一层不应该占一个 Agent 层级。**

字段统一、来源登记、exact dedupe 都让主控代码直接做：

```text
normalization = deterministic
```

不要再：

```text
Generators
↓
Canonicalizer Agent
↓
Reviewer
```

否则又凭空多一层。

只有像“这两个创意其实是不是同一路”这种真正需要判断的事情，才交给 Pair Reviewer。

所以我现在会把我们下一轮 entry 的主链定成：

```text
8 Generator 并行
        ↓
机械 normalization
        ↓
8 overlapping 2-generator Reviewer 并行
        ↓
机械 survivor union
        ↓
ROUGH FEED PDF
        ↓
你
```

**这应该是下一次第一次看结果的节点。**

这比当前的 29→19→五轮 Reviewer/Judge 要快非常多，同时也不是简单牺牲质量：我们把原来串行的“多次纠错”变成了**同一层里的重复独立审查**。我觉得这是我们这种 Agent 成本结构下更合理的 architecture。memcite

[L2]   "content": "preferred_slot: A  \ndifference: MATERIAL  \nremaining_material_issue: NO  \nremaining_review_value: ENTRY_STRATEGY_CONVERGED  \n\nreason:  \nSLOT A 更完整地建立了“真实产品价值 → 入口 package 信号 → audience-dependent decode → self-selection / mis-selection → first-contact fulfillment → post-entry fit → return motive → 20–50 支后的 audience mix / channel category”这一整条因果链。优势不是 family 更多或文字更长，而是它保留了更多**会改变选择结果的 motive 差异**，并把这些差异落实到了信号解码、false positive、false negative、首触兑现和长期迁移机制中。尤其是它把 articulation、recognition-without-advice、experience intensification、whole-process close reading、competence insecurity 分开处理；SLOT B 虽然已经有很强的 motive-based audience model，但仍把其中几种 source-supported motivation 压缩到较宽的 “experiential articulation / nonclassical close reader” 桶里，因此无法同样精确地解释为什么同一个 causal、psychological、guided 或 seriousness signal 会吸引一种高-fit audience、同时误排另一种高-fit audience。A 对 Experience/psychology expansion 也不是单纯“更激进”：它要求 piece/object、specific process、time/method、effort、model-not-verdict 五项 checksum，并增加 temporally separated support、remove-piece、therapy-account transplant、first-contact fulfillment 和 post-entry high-fit proof，使 growth 与 mis-selling 的区别真正可执行。A 将 competence permission 从独立 reward family 改成跨 family barrier overlay 也有实质因果依据：相关报告既把 competence barrier 当真实 selection mechanism，也明确警告它一旦成为长期 category 会训练 beginner/remedial audience；A 没有删除这类 audience，而是更清楚地区分了“进入障碍”与“用户进入后回来消费的 primary reward”。标题、thumbnail text、visual、series identity 在两版里都被当作一个协同 entry package，平台层具体表现也都正确留为 empirical unknown。B 的主要相对优势是更忠实保留了多数报告关于 perceptual/perceptual-causal lane 作为 lower-distortion default spine 的综合判断；A 的 “no global default family” 是其最值得保留警惕的一项编辑判断。但 A 同时保留稳定 category contract、逐曲 eligibility、family concentration audit，并把相对 qualified reach 明确留待验证，所以这一点不足以抵消它在 audience-selection completeness 上的实质领先。\n\nmaterial examples:\n- **Recognition ≠ articulation ≠ therapy demand。** A04 报告明确单列 recognition/articulation seeker，A01 也区分“被说中”动机。SLOT A 建立 `recognition_without_advice_seeker`，并给 “被说中” signal 单独建模：它可以强吸引真正高-fit 的语言/recognition 用户，也会高概率吸入 self-help 用户，修复方式是把语法主语留在作品/process 并加 music-time checksum。SLOT B 有 experiential articulation，但没有同等独立的 recognition selection path。\n- **Feeling-first high-fit false negative。** A04 明确指出 causal framing 可能排斥 `feeling-first high-fit listener`。SLOT A 有独立 `experience_intensifier`，并明确记录 WHY/lecture signal 对这类人的排斥；SLOT B 没有同等独立状态，因此这一类 false-negative 机制较弱。\n- **“Guided” 本身是双向 selector。** 报告支持 competence-insecure 用户把 guidance 解码为 scaffold，同时 autonomy-sensitive experienced 用户可能解码为 hand-holding/authority。SLOT A 将 `引导 / guided` 单独建成 polysemous signal，并给出两侧 decode 与 repair；SLOT B 的 method contract 很好，但这个具体 signal interpretation 没有同等展开。\n- **Competence mechanism 的结构更干净。** SLOT B 保留 E-S006 作为第六 family，但又反复称其为 access grammar。SLOT A 把它改为 O01 overlay：仍完整建模 competence-insecure high-fit、course/quick-learning false positives、experienced-listener false negatives和 effort honesty，但避免把“允许进入”误当成长期消费 reward。A08 明确支持 “Competence-Bridge = accessibility grammar”，A05 也把它定位为 bounded bridge 而非主品牌，因此这不是删掉一个受众。\n- **Experience-first growth 的兑现链更强。** SLOT A 的 F03 要求 whole-process claim 至少有两个时间上分离的 source support，并同时通过 five-part checksum、remove-piece、therapy-transplant、first-contact fulfillment、post-entry high-fit rationale；这比仅指出“心理/self-help 风险”更直接回答了“怎样扩张而不误卖”。\n- **长期 audience mix 不只描述静态终点。** SLOT A 明确设计 hook-level fit → format-level fit 的迁移，例如 recognition hook 最终要转成“我回来是为了 music-bound synchronized close reading”，并定义失败迁移如“只点与当前人生问题相关的题目”。这更直接解释 entry selection 如何经过重复使用形成长期 audience composition。\n- **B 的重要优点仍应保留。** 多数独立报告把 Listening Resolution / Perceptual-Causal 定位为默认或第一主轴，只有 causal centrality 等存在显著 dissent。A 不设 global default 的做法应继续被当作 portfolio policy，而不是已经被证实的市场事实；但它没有造成 source-supported audience、selection mechanism、signal interpretation 或 strategy family 的实质遗漏。",

hand-holding/authority。SLOT A 将 `引导 / guided` 单独建成 polysemous signal，并给出两侧 decode 与 repair；SLOT B 的 method contract 很好，但这个具体 signal interpretation 没有同等展开。\n- **Competence mechanism 的结构更干净。** SLOT B 保留 E-S006 作为第六 family，但又反复称其为 access grammar。SLOT A 把它改为 O01 overlay：仍完整建模 competence-insecure high-fit、course/quick-learning false positives、experienced-listener false negatives和 effort honesty，但避免把“允许进入”误当成长期消费 reward。A08 明确支持 “Competence-Bridge = accessibility grammar”，A05 也把它定位为 bounded bridge 而非主品牌，因此这不是删掉一个受众。\n- **Experience-first growth 的兑现链更强。** SLOT A 的 F03 要求 whole-process claim 至少有两个时间上分离的 source support，并同时通过 five-part checksum、remove-piece、therapy-transplant、first-contact fulfillment、post-entry high-fit rationale；这比仅指出“心理/self-help 风险”更直接回答了“怎样扩张而不误卖”。\n- **长期 audience mix 不只描述静态终点。** SLOT A 明确设计 hook-level fit → format-level fit 的迁移，例如 recognition hook 最终要转成“我回来是为了 music-bound synchronized close reading”，并定义失败迁移如“只点与当前人生问题相关的题目”。这更直接解释 entry selection 如何经过重复使用形成长期 audience composition。\n- **B 的重要优点仍应保留。** 多数独立报告把 Listening Resolution / Perceptual-Causal 定位为默认或第一主轴，只有 causal centrality 等存在显著 dissent。A 不设 global default 的做法应继续被当作 portfolio policy，而不是已经被证实的市场事实；但它没有造成 source-supported audience、selection mechanism、signal interpretation 或 strategy family 的实质遗漏。",

本身已经很强，但这些差异直接影响题目要求的 audience-selection 与长期 audience-mix 设计，因此属于 MATERIAL，而非仅编辑性增强。\n\nmaterial examples:\n- A 的 F03 同时容纳 articulation、recognition、intensification 和 whole-process close reading；B 的 F03/F04 分别要求 local/near-local experiential evidence 与 distributed multi-unit/path-dependent evidence，并分别建模 quote/self-help FP 与 fixed-plot/general-human-topic FP，以及不同的 healthy return motive。\n- A01 明确提出来自电影配乐、爵士、progressive、完整专辑等聆听文化、耳朵并不缺能力而只是 classical category identity 不匹配的人群。A 没有独立保留这一路径；B 建立 `cross_genre_attentive_listener`，并让其通过 F01/F02/F04/F05 而不是 beginner-remediation 信号进入。\n- B 新增 `reward_locus_work_vs_self`、`verbal_intervention_appetite`、`format_migration_readiness`，以及 `topic_only_human_interest_browser`。这使“被说中但愿意继续听作品”“想获得治疗/建议”“只为一个大人生话题点进来”不再被混成同一种 psychology audience。\n- B 明确检查 title + thumbnail 的组合解码：例如 causal title + notation-first visual 会把 F02 误解成 formal analysis；recognition text + generic emotional art 会把 F03 误解成心理/金句内容；human-process text + portrait/story visual 会把 和产品。\n- B 对“不增加 family”的纪律仍然存在：competence 保持 overlay；“想感受更多”被明确建模但暂不升格；F03/F04 若无法证明独立 reward、FP/FN、fulfillment 与 return motive，合同要求重新合并。这使其新增 distinctness 不属于单纯 strategy inflation。",

[L2]   "content": "preferred_slot: B\n\ndifference: MATERIAL\n\nremaining_material_issue: NO\n\nremaining_review_value: ENTRY_STRATEGY_CONVERGED\n\nreason:  \nB 更完整地回答了核心因果链：**真实产品价值 → 入口 package signal → 不同 motive 的受众解码 → attraction / healthy repel / false positive / false negative → first-contact fit → cross-work return motive → 20–50 次重复后的 audience mix / channel identity / repertoire backflow**。A 已经是强版本，尤其在 perceptual、WHY_NOW、articulation/recognition、human-process、full-work ritual、interpretive agency、competence/effort overlays，以及 title + thumbnail joint decoding 上都很完整；但它在一个重要位置过早收缩：它承认 `想感受更多`、A05 feeling-first high-fit audience 和 experiential-intensification signal 都是真实的，却规定该信号不能成为独立 front door，理由主要是 audience migration、text-density acceptance 尚未实证。B 没有因为“多一个 family”而胜出；它胜在把这个此前已经存在、但没有被完整设计的 selection mechanism 补齐了。B 区分 **active felt intensifier** 与 **passive mood/background listener**，增加“语言作为实时注意力工具”的解码轴，并说明同样的 affective signal 为什么前者可以高 fit、后者则是 false positive。这个区别直接改变 package 设计、筛选逻辑、first-contact fulfillment、回访理由与长期 repertoire pressure，因此是 MATERIAL，而非命名上的 family inflation。来源支撑也足够形成“可主动测试的 provisional strategy”：A01 明确显示 AFFECT 贯穿全部 temporal units、54/80 atoms 且大量 multi-facet；A04 明确指出 explanation-heavy 路线会 false-negative 一个 `feeling-first high-fit listener`；多份报告把语言、实时注意和 experiential discrimination 视为产品真实作用。B 同时没有把未知量冒充事实：F05 的 audience size、同步文字是否被这群人体验为正向介入、active/passive filtering 效果、跨作品 migration 与低 arousal portability 仍被保留为 unresolved。因此它比 A 少一层 over-safe suppression，同时仍保持 evidence discipline。其余关键报告路线均已被建模；competence bridge、recognition 等没有“遗漏”，而是有明确因果理由分别作为 overlay 或 F03 内部 aperture 处理。平台 retrieval、标题顺序和 production copy 也继续正确 defer，而不是被伪装成普适平台规则。\n\nmaterial examples:\n- **A05 / “想感受更多”**：A 已建模这个 motive，却把它限制为 F03/F04/full-session 的 modifier，并规定 experiential-intensification cue “never use alone as a family-defining claim”。B 则建立 `F05 Active Felt Immersion`：primary reward 是当下更细、更鲜明的 felt encounter，而不是“命名准确”“理解为什么”或“完整 ritual”。这产生了不同的 target motive 和 entry proposition，而不只是多一个标签。\n- **关键 selection mechanism**：B 新增 `D24 language as attentional instrument`。它把“喜欢感受”继续拆成两类：愿意让同步语言参与注意/感知的 active intensifier，与认为文字本身破坏沉浸的 passive listener。A 有 language-intervention tolerance 与 density dimensions，但没有把这个**语言在体验中的功能差异**变成该 audience 的决定性筛选变量。\n- **False positive / false negative**：B 的 S08/S33/S34 明确说明 affective entry 如何吸引 A05/A07，同时怎样误吸 A17 passive mood、A15 self-help、A20 topic-only；也解释 totalizing affect wording 怎样反而排除 autonomy-sensitive high-fit users。A 能看到 mood false positive，却缺少同等完整的 active-feel positive selection path。\n- **Growth without mis-selling**：B 不是用更弱的情绪信号保安全，而是要求 `piece/time checksum + synchronized-method visibility + effort honesty + non-totalizing affect`。因此解决方案是**让真实 affective value 更显著，同时用真实产品机制筛人**，而不是隐藏该价值。\n- **Post-entry fit**：B 为 F05 定义了独立 fulfillment test——用户获得的不是“我情绪很强”，而是同步语言/时间注意本身参与了更细的当下体验；健康回访理由是“让另一首、甚至不同 affective surface 的作品也通过这个方法变得更可感”，从而把 topic/mood return 与 method return 分开。\n- **长期 audience shaping**：B 增加了 A 缺失的 F05-specific feedback loop：generic affective hook → passive/mood audience → 指标奖励高 arousal → repertoire 反向偏向悲剧、高潮、宣泄 → channel 逐渐成为 emotional spectacle。它同时要求用 restrained / ambiguous / low-arousal repertoire 验证这一路线。这是对长期 audience mix 的实质新增模型。\n- **没有牺牲 A 的已有优点**：B 仍保留 perceptual re-hearing、WHY_NOW、articulation/recognition、distributed human-process、full-work ritual、interpretive agency；仍显式建模 competence false negatives、theory/story/self-help false positives、cross-genre latent users、effort truth、joint title+thumbnail collision，以及 20–50 release category debt。\n- **证据边界仍在**：B 没有声称 F05 已证明更高 CTR、更大 audience 或更强 retention；这些仍是 empirical unknown。它只是把“未知效果”从“不能成为 front door”的禁令改成“可以作为有明确高-fit hypothesis、filter 和 kill conditions 的主动测试 family”。这更符合 locked context 的 `Unknown ≠ NONE`，又没有把 UNKNOWN 升级成已验证效果。",

反向偏向悲剧、高潮、宣泄 → channel 逐渐成为 emotional spectacle。它同时要求用 restrained / ambiguous / low-arousal repertoire 验证这一路线。这是对长期 audience mix 的实质新增模型。\n- **没有牺牲 A 的已有优点**：B 仍保留 perceptual re-hearing、WHY_NOW、articulation/recognition、distributed human-process、full-work ritual、interpretive agency；仍显式建模 competence false negatives、theory/story/self-help false positives、cross-genre latent users、effort truth、joint title+thumbnail collision，以及 20–50 release category debt。\n- **证据边界仍在**：B 没有声称 F05 已证明更高 CTR、更大 audience 或更强 retention；这些仍是 empirical unknown。它只是把“未知效果”从“不能成为 front door”的禁令改成“可以作为有明确高-fit hypothesis、filter 和 kill conditions 的主动测试 family”。这更符合 locked context 的 `Unknown ≠ NONE`，又没有把 UNKNOWN 升级成已验证效果。",

[L2]   "content": "preferred_slot: B\n\ndifference: MATERIAL\n\nremaining_material_issue: NO\n\nremaining_review_value: ENTRY_STRATEGY_CONVERGED\n\nreason: Slot B more completely explains the causal chain from truthful product externalization → audience-specific signal decoding → selection / mis-selection → post-entry fit → long-run audience mix. The decisive advantage is not that B has more strategy families; it is that B captures a source-supported **transitional selection mechanism** that A incorrectly collapses into an overlay, while simultaneously tightening an overclaim in A’s feeling-first strategy. B also repairs internal audience-routing ambiguities, makes false-positive attraction distinct from qualified routes, and gives title + thumbnail + visual a clearer joint-decoding contract. A remains strong on product richness, longitudinal shaping, and detailed exposition, but two errors are strategically material: treating competence recalibration as incapable of being a primary entry strategy merely because it should not become a durable brand, and describing F05 in causal “intensification / makes experience more vivid” terms that the supplied evidence does not establish. B keeps both growth apertures active without either suppressing them for safety or selling beyond product truth. Platform-specific retrieval, ranking, layout, and performance questions remain correctly deferred as empirical unknowns. Across the eight reports, I do not find another materially distinct audience-selection mechanism or strategy family that is supported strongly enough and absent from B to justify continued reviewer iteration.\n\nmaterial examples:\n- **Competence / access selection:** A01 explicitly constructs `COMPETENCE RESET`, A05 constructs `GUIDED ACCESS / COMPETENCE BRIDGE`, and A08 retains `COMPETENCE-BRIDGE` as an occasional acquisition lane while warning against making it the permanent identity. A recognizes the audience but forces competence into O01 because it lacks a durable same-family return reward. That confuses “not a permanent channel identity” with “not a real entry mechanism.” B’s F08 fixes this with D25 prerequisite-barrier salience, a concrete capability-without-simplification signal, explicit course/low-effort false positives, experienced/cross-genre false negatives, post-entry migration, and a sunset condition.\n- **Feeling-first value without mis-selling:** A correctly notices the important feeling-first high-fit false negative, but F05 `Active Felt Immersion / Experiential Intensification` goes beyond what product evidence proves; its own return language says the method “makes musical experience more vivid.” The reports themselves repeatedly note that verbal framing can alter experience in either direction and does not guarantee enhancement. B preserves the aggressive aperture as `Present-Tense Felt Tracking / Experiential Contact`, explicitly separates it from passive immersion, and adds an amplification-overclaim kill test. This is stronger evidence discipline without becoming more conservative in audience reach.\n- **Audience-selection data model:** A contains a substantive internal contradiction: D05 says experiential-intensification family status “remains unproven” even though F05 has already been admitted. It also puts low-fit states such as self-help seekers, story seekers, passive-immersion listeners, and course learners under `best_entry_routes` even when those families are described as their false-positive pathways. B separates `qualified_routes` from `misleading_attraction_routes`, corrects D05, adds D25, and makes A08’s F08 route explicit. That materially improves downstream actionability and false-positive modeling.\n- **Signal decoding:** Both candidates understand that signals are audience-dependent and that title and thumbnail cannot be judged independently. B goes further where the source evidence required it: `competence_recalibration_primary_cue`, `capability_without_simplification_joint_signal`, and `beginner_identity_foreground` distinguish truthful access from remedial branding. Its package brief separately records category, competence, effort, and mediation decodes, while its collision table tests the combined title/text/visual package rather than treating components as isolated marketing assets.\n- **Post-entry and long-run shaping:** A already has a strong audience-debt/category-debt model. B preserves it and adds the missing bridge success criterion—F08 is successful precisely when converted users later stop needing F08—and a useful `mediation debt` concept for F05/F08 packages that attract by hiding the dense synchronized-language transaction. This connects acquisition signals more completely to eventual audience composition instead of treating a successful click or even first-session fit as the endpoint.\n- **No material shared omission found:** The report families map substantively into B’s perceptual re-hearing, WHY-NOW causality, articulation/recognition, distributed human-process, present-tense experiential contact, full-session/ritual, interpretive openness, and bounded competence bridge. Piece-first/deep-companion variants are covered by F01/F06 rather than requiring another family; competence overlays remain available when the barrier is secondary; low-intervention/full-work control behavior is represented by F06; theory, biography, therapy, passive-performance, curriculum, and definitive-answer audiences are modeled as distinct mis-selection channels rather than collapsed into a generic “bad audience.”",

**产品真实价值 → title/thumbnail/visual/series 的联合信号 → 不同 audience 的不同 decode → attract / repel / false positive / false negative → first-contact fulfillment → cross-work return / migration → 20–50 次发布后的 audience mix 与 channel identity** 连成一条可执行的因果链。A 在 audience micro-model 和单信号枚举上略丰富，尤其把 present-tense felt tracking 独立建成 family，也更细地拆出 self-relevance、diagnostic wording 等信号；但 B 没有删除这些重要受众或价值，而是保留 felt-contact audience 和 CONTACT mode，同时要求一个 family 必须在 reward、source scope、selection mechanism、first-contact、FP/FN、return object、long-run identity 等维度真正不同。八份报告支持 experience/feeling-first 受众的重要性，但并没有形成足够独立证据证明 felt tracking 必须是一个与 articulation 具有不同长期选择机制的 standalone family，因此 B 的合并是 distinctness 改善，不是保守删减。更关键的是，B 把 title + thumbnail + visual 明确作为一个 **joint signal stack** 来推理：同一 psychology-adjacent 文本搭配 product-native time/interface 可以修复分类，搭配 generic affective visual 则会强化错误分类；这比 A 主要依靠 component ledger 加 collision table 更直接地设计了真实入口 package 的 audience selection。B 的长期模型也明显更完整：不仅写每个 family 的 20–50-release identity，还建模 selection reinforcement、expectation/category reinforcement、competence debt、closure debt、mediation debt、topic loyalty、family concentration、repertoire backflow，以及 F07→价值 family、F03/F04→method loyalty 等 migration path，并给出 expand / repair / sunset 条件。这使“增长但不误卖”真正延伸到了长期 audience composition，而非只停留在单次点击和单集 fit。B 同时保持 active experiential / human-process growth，不因 psychology-adjacent 或 competence 风险而退回安全的作品名包装；未知效应被明确留作实验，而不是当作 NONE。平台层面也正确停在 semantic-role 层，把中文平台 retrieval、surface differences、CTR elasticities 留为 empirical unknown。\n\nmaterial examples:\n- **Joint package decoding:** B 的 `EXPERIENCE_EXPANSION_WITH_CHECKSUM` 同时要求 experiential/human reward、exact piece、product-native temporal method 和 visible effort；并有 `FALSE_PSYCHOLOGY_CATEGORY`、`FALSE_BEGINNER_CATEGORY` 等整包反例。A 已认识 signal collision，但其 causal ledger 仍更偏逐信号建模，并把 joint-signal interaction 留作重要 unresolved。\n- **Feeling-first audience没有被牺牲:** A 把 A05 / Present-Tense Felt Tracking 单列 F05；B 仍保留 `felt_contact_seeker`、F03 `CONTACT mode`、“explanation-heavy framing 会造成 feeling-first FN”、passive/no-text 与 active mediated feeling 的区别，以及 emotional-amplification 禁区。变化只是把没有充分独立 causal identity 的 family 合并，而不是把这一受众重新隐藏掉。\n- **Long-term audience mix:** A 已有 family 20–50 次重复的风险和 repertoire debt；B 进一步描述 selection → expectation → category 的自我强化、topic-only return、competence/closure debt、family-concentration debt，并把“用户为什么下一次还来”作为 portfolio-level selection outcome。\n- **Competence bridge:** 两版都正确恢复了 serious-but-competence-insecure audience，并区分它与 low-effort beginner/course demand；B 更明确要求 bridge 的成功表现为后续不再需要 competence reassurance，并规定 migration target 与 sunset，而不是把新手身份当 retention。\n- **False positives / false negatives:** 两版都覆盖 theory seeker、therapy/self-help、fixed-story/biography、passive listening、definitive-answer、curriculum、topic-only 等 FP，同时保留 autonomy-sensitive experts、cross-genre sophisticated listeners、feeling-first users、competence-excluded serious users等高价值 FN。B 将这些直接嵌入 package tests、kill/repair codes 和 return-object test，执行闭环更强。\n- **Source/report coverage:** 八份报告中的 perceptual/re-hearing、WHY_NOW causal、experiential/articulation/human-process、full-work session、interpretive openness、competence bridge，以及 cross-domain / causal-system / cross-genre / long-form / classical-curious latent pools，在 B 中都有可识别的 strategy 或 audience route；没有发现两版共同遗漏且由来源支持的重要 audience type、selection mechanism 或 strategy family。",
